title: Remove wall-clock dependency from EngramControlGate tests
outcome: Direct cargo test tests::engram_host_adapter -- --nocapture launches 149 tests at the default runner concurrency. On 2026-08-29 it caused  ailed_stop_during_in_flight_begin_resumes_the_owned_prompt_delivery to exceed EngramControlGate::wait's 2-second recv_timeout; the exact isolated test passed in 1.06s. The required scripts/test-rust.sh wrapper bounds Rust parallelism, so this is a test-harness/resource defect rather than a product failure. Replace the wall-clock gate handshake with a deterministic completion/disconnection protocol (do not merely widen the timeout), or make the module invocation use the same bounded runner contract.
disposal_reason: NOT PLANNED (backlog triage w-930e4d333f07, 2026-10-05; Greg's approval via Engram::Advisor #293). P3/P4, never started, no holder or children, untouched since before 2026-09-21, not reliability, data safety or pilot. The record is kept; reopen or re-file if it becomes relevant.
